programme.desc: S3:E7 Épisode 7 - Pingu colmate une fuite | Pingu et Pinga fashionistas | Continue comme ça, Pingu ! | La pêche du jour de Pingu

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: S3:E8 Épisode 8 - Arrêtez ce courrier ! | Collés ensemble | Tout le monde est gagnant ! | Les douleurs de la croissance

programme.title: Adversaires
programme.desc: Freddie part faire de l'escrime avec Spencer. Il s'en sort bien, mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Spencer se retrouve impliqué dans un match avec l'incroyable Doug Toder.

programme.title: Je gagne un rencard
programme.desc: Gibby est trop timide pour demander à la fille qui lui plait de sortir avec lui, le groupe décide alors d'organiser une tranche "je gagne un rendez-vous" sur leur émission.

programme.title: Ma prof est folle
programme.desc: Madame Ackerman, le professeur du groupe, est en pleine rupture avec son petit-ami, ce qui la rend aigrie avec ses étudiants. Une visite de Spencer pour arranger les choses se transforme en rendez-vous.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: Je lai vu la première
programme.desc: Carly et Sam s'intéressent au même garçon, mais elles se jurent qu'il ne sèmera pas la zizanie entre elles. Malheureusement, les choses ne se déroulent pas si facilement et elles finissent par entrer en compétition.

programme.title: Pak-Rat
programme.desc: Spencer devient accro à un jeu-vidéo et Carly doit intervenir. De son côté, Sam fait croire à Freddie qu'il est maudit pour avoir refusé de transmettre une lettre chaîne.

programme.title: Pour une poignée de dollars
programme.desc: Sam se sent insultée quand Freddie l'accuse de ne pas rembourser l'argent qu'elle emprunte. Du coup elle va tout faire pour effacer ses dettes. Voyant le travail qu'elle fournit, Sam et Carly décident de l'aider secrètement.

programme.title: Jembête Lewbert
programme.desc: Alors qu'une histoire d'amour est sur le point de naître entre Lewbert et Mme Benson, la bande décide de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Cest pas de la tarte
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Spencer emmènent Freddie dans leur boutique de tartes préférée. A leur arrivée, ils apprennent que le propriétaire a disparu en emportant la recette des tartes avec lui.

programme.title: Spencer est normal
programme.desc: Alors qu'il souhaite pimenter un peu la tradition de Noël avec un arbre peu conventionnel, Spencer met accidentellement le feu aux cadeaux de Carly. Bouleversée, elle rêve d'avoir un frère normal.

programme.title: Le premier baiser
programme.desc: Alors que Freddie confie à Carly qu'il n'a jamais embrassé une fille, Sam surprend leur conversation et dévoile le secret de Freddie sur Internet.

programme.title: Le concours
programme.desc: L'équipe organise un concours sur iCarly.com pour gagner une voiture.

programme.title: Meilleurs ennemis
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie vexent une starlette du web dénommée Fred. Ce dernier tente alors de convaincre ses abonnés vidéo de ne plus jamais regarder iCarly.

programme.title: Terreur sur l'asphalte
programme.desc: Une série de meurtres mystérieux a eu lieu à Montevideo, une petite ville en Californie. La femme d'un policier s'enfuit de son mari, cherchant à divorcer. Le policier tente de se réconcilier et commence à la suivre...

programme.title: Le Dernier Train De La Nuit
programme.desc: Deux voyous psychotiques et une femme nymphomane tout aussi démente terrorisent deux jeunes filles lors d'un voyage en train entre l'Allemagne et l'Italie.

programme.title: Cercle Infernal
programme.desc: La vie de deux sœurs change radicalement, depuis qu'elles ont été hypnotisées par un disque vinyle mystique des années 1970.

programme.title: Aux Portes De L'Enfer
programme.desc: Le révérend Jonah Johnson et sa femme Isabelle sont des télé-évangélistes arnaqueurs. Repérés par la police, ils doivent partir pour Los Angeles. Afin d'habiter un vieux manoir abandonné, ils acceptent un marché avec une vieille femme très riche, Lady Calagari. Le couple devra ériger un culte à la gloire de Satan. Dès lors, des événements surnaturels font leur apparition et des meurtres inexpliqués s'enchaînent.

programme.title: Time served
programme.desc: Quand un enfant tue son beau-père violent, sa mère se dénonce et est condamnée à une longue peine de prison.

programme.title: A.R.C.H.I.E Chien Robot
programme.desc: Isabel, 15 ans, part s'installer chez son oncle dans une peLte ville des Etats-Unis après la mort de ses parents. Sa vie change le jour où elle rencontre Archie, un chien robot très convoité aux pouvoirs extraordinaires…

programme.title: Les Aventures de Billy Stone, le médaillon sacré
programme.desc: L'archéologue Michael Stone a passé sa vie à rechercher un médaillon magique. C'est finalement son fils Billy qui parvient à le retrouver, mais une mauvaise manipulation libère le pouvoir de l'artefact. L'adolescent et son amie Allie se retrouvent projetés dans le temps et l'espace.

programme.title: L'Odyssée d'Albert: Chapitre 1
programme.desc: Chris, un adolescent aventureux, aide un gentil dinosaure à échapper aux griffes d'un scientifique fou, le docteur Jost, qui veut utiliser l'animal à des fins d'expérimentation.

programme.title: A.R.I
programme.desc: Noah, un jeune garcon un peu geek, découvre un robot qui semble abandonné dans une poubelle du laboratoire où travaille son père. Il le ramène à la maison et tente de le réparer.

programme.title: Foxter & Max
programme.desc: Un pré-adolescent artistique et frustré découvre que le chien graffiti qu'il a peint avec une boîte trouvée de ce qu'il pensait être de la peinture en aérosol, a pris vie sous la forme d'un super-chien ultra-intelligent fait de nanobots.

programme.title: Battle for Skyark
programme.desc: Dans un monde post-apocalyptique, Rags, un jeune exilé marqué par une prophétie, mène une bande d'orphelins contre des monstres afin de sauver l'humanité et ramener la paix entre la Terre et la cité céleste de Sky Ark.

programme.title: Two Warriors : le combat du siècle
programme.desc: Un champion de boxe japonais jusque là invaincu se prépare à affronter un challenger américain. Sur fond de tensions politiques, le parcours parallèle des deux athlètes les poussera jusque dans leurs derniers retranchements.

programme.title: Burner
programme.desc: Kiki, mère célibataire tout juste sortie de prison, pense enfin pouvoir repartir à zéro avec sa fille. Mais le retour de son ex, un dealer violent, fait voler sa nouvelle vie en éclats. Pour se sauver elle-même et protéger sa fille, Kiki doit trouver un moyen de se débarrasser de son ex… et de s'en tirer sans être inquiétée.

programme.title: La loi de Brooklyn
programme.desc: Un ancien détenu se voit entraîné dans une brutale guerre de territoire avec la mafia Russe, ce qui le force à replonger dans son passé trouble afin d'utiliser les techniques de survie apprises dans l'une des plus violentes prisons.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Dans une société totalitaire née après une pandémie dévastatrice, chaque citoyen doit accepter un contrat lui garantissant vingt ans de sécurité avant une mort programmée. À quelques jours de son échéance, Tala se lance dans un ultime combat pour empêcher sa fille de devenir à son tour prisonnière de ce système impitoyable.

programme.title: J'aime beaucoup ta mère
programme.desc: Stéphane, quarante ans, une ancienne petite terreur du collège rend visite à sa mère. Celle-ci doit lui présenter son nouveau compagnon : Martin Mollard, sa tête de turc du collège….

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: Ni vu ni connu
programme.desc: Embauché par une femme qui se pense trompée, pour kidnapper et corriger la maîtresse de son mari, un escroc à la petite semaine met au point avec une de ses connaissances une combine pour empocher facilement l'argent. Mais le jour de la confrontation, les choses prennent un tour inattendu.

programme.title: Il faut qu'on parle
programme.desc: Nous avons tous quitté un jour, un(e) conjoint(e) sans raisons valables, si ce n'est l'envie de passer à autre chose. Et bien c'est ce que va faire le personnage d'Adam. Mais l'annonce de sa décision ne va pas se passer comme prévue…

programme.title: Où elle est maman ?
programme.desc: Roberto, Pablo et Sacha sont trois frères. Il y a quelques jours ils viennent de perdre leur maman. Leur papa, Joseph, semble ne pas se préoccuper de la situation. Pour lui, son épouse est encore là. C'est dans cet étrange contexte que les trois hommes vont devoir accompagner leur père dans cet instant difficile, de la marche funèbre à cette nuit où il va disparaître.

programme.title: Underwater
programme.desc: Jeanne Clairsen, "Oreille d'Or" dans la marine, est appelée par le Commissaire Delattre, afin qu'elle perce tous les bruits qui apporteraient la preuve qu'une nouvelle victime est bien détenue chez le suspect qu'ils ont mis sur écoute.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: Marche arrière
programme.desc: Juin 2013. Un mouvement protestataire occupe le parc Gezi à Istanbul. La tension monte entre les manifestants et la police qui se montre de plus en plus violente. Pendant ce temps, la télévision turque diffuse des documentaires sur les pingouins. Marche arrière est un film autocensuré dénonçant cette censure.

programme.title: Jacques a soif
programme.desc: Jacques a soif mais son PMU ne veut plus de lui et ses poches sont vides.

programme.title: Mon plus beau mariage
programme.desc: Une jeune femme regarde la vitrine d'une boutique de robes de mariées. Elle s'imagine dans chacune des robes le jour de son mariage. Laquelle va-t-elle choisir ?

programme.title: Tranche de campagne
programme.desc: Le soleil brille sur la campagne. Une famille d'animaux se trouve un endroit plaisant pour pique-niquer. À proximité, une bête broute paisiblement. L'ambiance bucolique de ce déjeuner sur l'herbe va changer…

programme.title: Un conte de la Goutte d'or
programme.desc: Dans le quartier de la Goutte d'or, quatre jeunes solitaires que rien ne lie, vont se rencontrer à la suite de minuscules incidents. S'en suit une aventure au coeur de l'un des plus célèbres quartiers de Paris.

programme.title: Regarder Oana
programme.desc: Oana travaille. Et moi je la regarde. Ce soir, ce dernier dossier sera plié. Elle ne veut plus traduire les mots des autres. Elle pense que demain elle va commencer à écrire pour elle. Mais elle ne le fera pas. Je le sais....

programme.title: Bleu-Gris
programme.desc: Fin août. Corse. Elbe, dix-sept ans, sourde de naissance est en vacances chez sa grande sœur Mathilde. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au phare de la Revellata, elle aperçoit un homme qui remonte seul d'une plongée sous marine…

programme.title: Rase campagne
programme.desc: Un village perdu dans la campagne finistérienne. Un homme est suspecté d'être porteur du virus Ebola. Il est noir. C'est Maurice. Son meilleur ami, Michel, ambulancier, sillonne le territoire avec son stagiaire Rémi pour le retrouver et le contrôler…

programme.title: Les amoureuses
programme.desc: Sara a quinze ans elle passe ses journées d'été au bord de la piscine accompagnée de sa mère, de sa petite sœur et de ses copines. La fin du mois d'août sera traversée par la rencontre d'un jeune homme, Lilian, pour lequel Sara et sa mère éprouvent le même désir.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Traversées
programme.desc: Ca tourne, ça virevolte, ça chute... sur la patinoire. Agile ou grotesque, chacun s'essaie à l'art du patinage. Le film est une ode. Ode à cette vie précaire, ode à cette arène où tant de personnes sont passées pour une heure, une journée, un amour...

programme.title: The Face, The Heel... et Corentin
programme.desc: Corentin est un nouvel élève du catch club de Cognac. Réservé, sincère et persévérant, le jeune homme se donne à fond pour atteindre son objectif : lutter aux Etats-Unis ou à l'étranger. Mais a-t-il l'étoffe d'un catcheur pour y parvenir ?

programme.title: GANGNAM ZOMBIES
programme.desc: Des citoyens du quartier huppé de Gangnam à Séoul commencent à présenter des symptômes inhabituels et terrifiants, se transformant en créatures inhumaines, ne laissant que quelques survivants avec une chance de s'en sortir vivants.

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: Le Manteau de Chicago
programme.desc: Le Chicago Outfit fut le syndicat du crime organisé le plus puissant du XXe siècle, et Lou Marazano (Frank Vincent) en était le tueur à gages le plus redouté.Vingt ans après sa vague de meurtres la plus célèbre, Lou est devenu une relique : sa légende s'est effacée, son talent oublié, et ses heures de gloire sont derrière lui.Mais lorsque l'arrestation d'un influent représentant syndical pour fraude fiscale menace de révéler une vaste conspiration impliquant policiers, élus et mafieux, le grand patron du Outfit (Armand Assante) ordonne l'élimination de témoins-clés.Pour Lou, c'est l'occasion rêvée de financer sa retraite et de fuir Chicago avec sa compagne (Kathrine Narducci).Mais deux détectives tenaces (Danny Goldring et Stacy Keach) se lancent à ses trousses, et le parrain par intérim (Mike Starr) décide de l'exclure du Outfit.Lou va devoir prouver qu'il mérite toujours son titre d'homme de main le plus meurtrier du Chicago Outfit — un titre qu'il n'a plus porté depuis plus de vingt ans…

programme.title: Don't Be Afraid Of The Dark
programme.desc: Alex, sa fille Sally, 8 ans, et sa compagne, Kim, s'installent au manoir de Blackwood, à Rhode Island. Dès la première nuit, Sally découvre le terrible secret de la maison. Des créatures hostiles hantent les lieux et se livrent chaque nuit à divers actes de malveillance. Mais Alex et Kim accusent Sally...

programme.title: My Soul To Take
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville de Riverton, la légende clame qu'un serial killer a juré de revenir assassiner les sept enfants nés la nuit où il est mort. Aujourd'hui, seize ans plus tard, de nouvelles personnes disparaissent. Le psychopathe s'est-il réincarné dans l'un des sept ados, ou a-t-il survécu à cette nuit où il fut laissé pour mort ?

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: Sarah Winchester, riche héritière de l'entreprise d'armes Winchester Rifle, construit une maison après la mort tragique de son mari et son fils. Elle croit que sa famille est maudite par les fantômes de tous ceux tués par ses armes et construit donc une maison pendant 38 ans pour y emprisonner les mauvais esprits. Eric Price, un psychiatre au passé trouble, est engagé pour déterminer si Sarah Winchester est folle, ou pas…

programme.title: Monsieur Lazhar
programme.desc: À Montréal, une enseignante du primaire meurt subitement. Bachir Lazhar, un immigrant algérien, est rapidement embauché pour la remplacer alors qu'il nage lui-même en pleine tragédie personnelle. Il apprend peu à peu à connaître un groupe d'enfants attachants, malgré le fossé culturel qui se manifeste dès la première leçon. Pendant que la classe amorce un processus de guérison, personne à l'école ne soupçonne le passé douloureux de Bachir, qui risque l'expulsion du pays à tout moment. Adapté d'une pièce de théâtre d'Evelyne de la Chenelière, Monsieur Lazhar met en images la rencontre de deux mondes et la puissance de la parole. Philippe Falardeau y suit avec humour et sensibilité un homme humble prêt à transcender sa propre perte pour aider les écoliers à vaincre le silence qui les emmure.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Deux employés d'une station essence utilisent leur entreprise comme facade pour camoufler leurs cambriolages. Un jour, ils s'en prennent à la mauvaise maison...

programme.title: Joe Baby
programme.desc: Chargée de récupérer 10 millions de dollars disparus dans une sombre affaire immobilière, Joe Baby, détective privée, se retrouve entraînée dans une affaire où tout semble ramener à la mort mystérieuse de son père, Walter Baby.

programme.title: Le pacte du mal
programme.desc: Diego est un médecin habitué à traiter des situations extrêmes. Si bien qu'il devient totalement immunisé à la douleur des autres. Quand Sara, une de ses patientes, tente de se suicider, son partenaire accuse Diego.

programme.title: La Panthère Rose
programme.desc: Un célèbre entraîneur de football est assassiné et sa bague, ornée du fameux diamant ‘'La Panthère Rose'' a disparu. L'inspecteur en chef Dreyfuss confie l'enquête à l'inspecteur Jacques Clouseau, le plus maladroit, le plus empoté, le plus incapable des agents de police.

programme.title: Arnaques, crimes et botanique
programme.desc: Quatre criminels, aimables mais mesquins, se retrouvent endettés auprès d'un gangster londonien après une partie de cartes truquée. Pour rembourser et sauver leurs peaux, ils décident de braquer des truands qui ont eux-mêmes braqué des dealers.

programme.title: Wishmaster
programme.desc: Le producteur exécutif Wes Craven nous livre ce classique culte de fantaisie-horreur qui a donné lieu à trois suites. Lorsqu'une experte en joaillerie reçoit une pierre précieuse ancienne, elle libère involontairement un esprit immortel qui réalise les vœux des humains en échange de leur âme.

programme.title: Wishmaster 2: Le mal ne meurt jamais
programme.desc: Le mal a été invoqué une fois de plus lorsque le Djinn maléfique est réveillé par un cambrioleur nommé Morgane (Fields) lors d'un hold-up d'art bâclé.Lorsque le Djinn prend la responsabilité du crime, il est envoyé en prison où il exauce des souhaits aux prisonniers en échange de leurs âmes, pour finalement structurer une armée pour anéantir toute l'humanité.C'est à Morgane de sauver la race humaine.

programme.title: Les condamnes 2
programme.desc: Randy Orton et Eric Roberts mettent le feu aux poudres dans cette suite explosive des Condamnés. Après que leur mission échoue pour capturer le chef d'un réseau de paris illégaux, Will Tanner, un chasseur de primes, devient la proie — la cible humaine d'un jeu où les concurrents doivent tuer ou être tués.

programme.title: Feel the Dance, Chante, Danse, Rêve
programme.desc: Cinq amies sont toutes unies par une passion : la musique, le chant et la danse. Leur objectif : créer un clip pour participer au plus grand concours musical de l'année. Leurs rivales : les Wiggies, qui les déstabiliseront par tous les moyens.

programme.title: Code 252: Signal de détresse
programme.desc: Suite à un tremblement de terre survenu à Tokyo, la température de l'Océan Pacifique grimpe dangereusement. Une tempête impressionnante, puis un tsunami s'abattent sur la ville. Des survivants vont tenter de transmettre le code 252, synonyme de secours.

programme.title: A Battle of wits
programme.desc: Une fresque retraçant la série de guerres civiles qui construisit la nation chinoise du cinquième siècle au troisième siècle avant J-C

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: D'après la légende, dans l'ancienne Grande-Bretagne, des forces saxonnes venues de l'Est attaquent le peuple celte. Mais tout n'est pas perdu. Arthur, un guerrier banni, et Merlin, un sorcier ermite, s'unissent, tels des héros, pour sauver le peuple.

programme.desc: Voix ouf met en avant le monde du doublage et les artistes cachés derrière nos héros préférés.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Ireland legend Louise Quinn Interview

She reflects on some of her career highlights including training in freezing temperatures, lifting the cup with Arsenal and her final game in the Irish jersey.

programme.title: I Humiliated A GB News Host On Live TV
programme.desc: Andy debriefs his televised clash with Matt Goodwin over accusations that the Gorton and Denton by-election candidate used AI to research his book. Seán and Andy revisit the best moments of the debate, from Goodwin's evasive answers to his use of ChatGPT to defend himself.

programme.title: How The Taliban Really Works
programme.desc: Sean Langan is a British journalist and documentary filmmaker who has spent decades reporting from some of the world's most dangerous conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq and Russia. He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right
programme.desc: Stephen Kapos is an 88-year-old Holocaust survivor who discusses his activism, his opposition to Israel's systemic destruction of Gaza and the West Bank, and how the memory of the Holocaust is being abused by Israel and the far-right.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran's Palestine Downfall
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran dropped Macklemore from his tour over the artist's pro-Palestine platform. He played his last gig alone, after all of his supporting artists and his backing band dropped out in solidarity. Ava and Seán break down what happened and react to Sheeran's apology.

programme.title: Did A GB News Host Write A Book Full Of AI Slop?
programme.desc: Andy investigates Matthew Goodwin's new book and uncovers significant issues with its content. After Goodwin's defeat in the Gorton and Denton by-election, his release is examined closely, with Andy and Ava challenging a series of claims that don't hold up. From questionable statistics about English language use in schools to references that appear to trace back to ChatGPT, the pair expose what is at the very least a lack of academic rigour.

programme.title: Minutes With
programme.desc: In this episode of Minutes With, we sat down with former spy Paul Hughes who gives us an insight into his varied life tracking terrorists in the Middle East and on counter-terror operations in the UK. We hear about his dangerous mission to find Osama bin Laden in Afghanistan after 9/11. Paul explains the tactics used by terrorist groups like al-Qaeda and the Taliban hiding in the mountains, as well as his terrifying experience of coming face to face with Saddam Hussein.

programme.title: Minutes With
programme.desc: Former trader Nick Leeson's actions led to $1.2 billion in losses and the collapse of one of Britain's oldest banks, ultimately ending in an international manhunt, and an eight-year sentence in a Singaporean prison alongside dangerous gangs.

programme.title: Minutes With
programme.desc: In this episode of Minutes With, we sit down with Sebastian Junger, a renowned journalist and filmmaker who has spent over 20 years documenting life on the front lines in war zones. Sebastian shares stories from his career in Bosnia, Afghanistan, and Liberia, recounting the most shocking events he's witnessed and delving into the ethical dilemmas faced by war journalists. He also reflects on the profound impact of a near-death experience he had in 2020, offering insights into how it has reshaped his perspective on life and work.

programme.title: Minutes With
programme.desc: This week, we spoke to Nick Dunn, who was wrongly imprisoned in Indian jails for four years. Nick was part of a shipping crew defending his boat from Somali pirates in the Indian Ocean when a cyclone threat forced them to dock off the coast of India. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Dangerous Trails: Elephants in the Minefield
programme.desc: This film tells the story of peace and resettlement in Angola. After decades of civil War, the Elephants are returning via routes riddled with landmines. We show the challenge of both elephants and people reclaiming their land and living together.

programme.title: Meet The Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Marsupials were once found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. Whether hopping, climbing or even airborne, marsupials are some of the strangest but most fascinating creatures you're likely to meet.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey on the border of two amazing worlds - beyond the turquoise waters of Raja Ampat, a paradise of diverse coral gardens, multitudes of fascinating species of fish and towering barrel sponges and up on the land where the unique cultures and ways of life, as well as struggles and triumphs of the people who call this remote and stunning corner of the world home are shown.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.sub-title: Grim Testament About One Snotty Boy
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.sub-title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories

One day Anya's mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! It turned out that the stolen silver was successful and came to hand over the stolen silver to Johnson. After the two exchanged greetings, Zhuang Yuchen finally did not issue a warning to Jiang Chengyi, but let the masked man start following Jiang Chengyi. programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Medicine
programme.desc: Dr. Harold 'Fred' Shipman was known as a dedicated, hardworking and community-minded doctor who spent his life gaining the trust of his patients and the respect of his colleagues. And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history's most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. Shipman's patients seem to be dying at an unusually high rate, and their dead bodies had a similarity when he called to collect them – almost all were elderly women who lived alone and they died sitting in chairs while fully clothed. “There was never anything in the house that I saw that indicated the person had been ill,” the undertaker remembers. “It just seems the person, where they were, had died. There was something that didn't quite fit.” Shipman is found guilty and given fifteen life sentences. A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR

On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM

Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Alien Convergence

programme.title: Alienate
programme.desc: Una coppia in crisi decide di trascorrere il weekend separata. Ma quando aerei iniziano a precipitare e un'invasione aliena sconvolge il pianeta, Dave intraprende un viaggio disperato per tornare a casa e ritrovare la moglie, attraversando un mondo ormai precipitato nel caos.

programme.title: Hard night falling
programme.desc: Durante una cena nella lussuosa villa della famiglia Rossini, il criminale Goro e la sua banda prendono in ostaggio gli invitati per rubare un'ingente quantità d'oro. Ignorano però che tra gli ospiti c'è Michael Anderson (Dolph Lundgren), un agente dell'Interpol altamente addestrato, determinato a salvare la sua famiglia e sventare il colpo.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: The Eye
